youtube.description:
Kiro Autopilot vs Supervised mode: 4 differences

Autopilot versus Supervised in Kiro. Four differences.

1. The default - Autopilot is the default. Supervised is a switch you choose.
2. The approvals - Autopilot keeps going. Supervised waits for your approval after edits.
3. The best fit - Autopilot suits routine work. Supervised suits high-stakes code.
4. The catch - Autopilot is not a model picker. Model routing is called Auto.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/ide/chat/autopilot/
